title: ft_print_comb
statement:
Write a program that prints every possible combination of 3 different
digits, in ascending order, each digit being between 0 and 9. The digits
inside a combination must be in strictly increasing order, and the
combinations themselves must be sorted in ascending lexicographic order.

Combinations are separated by ", " and the output ends with a newline.
Example (truncated): "012, 013, 014, ..., 789\n"

You may only use the write() system call. Your file must define main().
